decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that fully captures the backlight circuit, supply-selection, and component-population semantics relevant to this Requirement.
The source specifies J_DISP_LED population details for the current build but does not change the required sensor-board production-file package.
The J_DISP_LED population decision does not change the manufacturer-order assistance, account setup, or ordering sequence.
The source selects and populates backlight-circuit parts but does not modify the existing policy requiring sourceable and cost-conscious components.
The backlight component and population specification does not alter KiCad project portability or library resolution.
J_DISP_LED uses a separate GPIO42-controlled backlight circuit; the source does not change the GPIO5-switched 5V sensor rail or its loads.
The source's gate, series-resistor, and decoupling details concern J_DISP_LED and do not change I2C pull-ups or signal-conditioning resistors.
The gate pull-down used to keep the backlight off during boot is incidental to the BOOT/reset circuit and does not change its controls or capacitance.
The J_DISP_LED connection and population choices do not affect the SPS30 SEL-to-GND connection or required I2C mode.
Although the source describes an LED behind the e-paper display, it does not necessarily modify the enclosure cutout, mounting, airflow, retention, or existing LED light-transmission requirement.
Providing an unpopulated 3.3V fallback jumper for the backlight does not change the DCDC1 configuration or the regulated 3.3V system-rail target.
The J_DISP_LED population specification does not affect the AXP2101 exposed-pad thermal-transfer requirement.
